A fresh non-executing replay regenerated all seven canonical static, conversion, compile-plan, and quarantine evidence/report files byte-for-byte with zero hash or length mismatches; it did not persist, compile, load MT5, load the vendor DLL, or read the demo credential file.

The security-sanitized current corpus is exactly 198 files and 12,979,438 bytes under SHA-256 9a53e844cfd3ffe5dfcf28544bb4909ce69741ac6a373e80b139f8227779dd47; the compile plan covers exactly 166 canonical .mq5 targets, has 12 intrinsic candidates and 0 locally dispatch-ready targets, and its formatted metadata file is exactly 455,612 bytes.
All 32 .mqh files have conversion-evidence dispositions: 17 awaiting isolated type-check, 1 missing dependency, 13 unsupported semantics, and 1 external-dependency snapshot.
Migration 002, strict C# contracts and role adapters, and production PostgresUserOperationWorkStore integration implement requested-v4/result-v5 attempt and challenge scheduling/state transitions.

The reconciliation SECURITY DEFINER boundary enforces the fixed worker actor before input validation and binds operation correlation before authority/row locking; branch-complete negative facts prove no evidence disclosure, mutation, or retained row lock.
PG18 integration evidence uses a deterministic non-broker provider; it does not prove authenticated production transport, provider invocation, restart recovery, or a broker outcome.

openBlockers.detail: Requested-v4/result-v5 and challenge database/C# scaffolding plus production PostgresUserOperationWorkStore integration exist, but no authenticated outbox consumer/destination or Supervisor/Gateway/credential-boundary ingress, handoff, and return transport is wired. The production secret provider, provider/observer invoker, and restart coordinator are also absent. Protocol remains disabled by design.

No trusted component authenticates immutable broker observations, derives broker-dependent risk inputs and exposure, binds current policy/risk-day/order-rate state, and authorizes a production broker command. Caller-supplied risk input remains rejected.

Database/C# reconciliation-challenge issuance, consumption, canonical result handling, and production work-store scheduling are implemented. No authenticated transport/provider/restart path has exercised them against a real broker, so crash/unknown proof remains unproven; ambiguous operations can remain unknown and readiness unhealthy by design.

The legacy v2 mutation envelope lacks database-owned capability expiry, assignment lease, fence, and bounded execution-deadline fields. An execution-enabled receiver must use the requested-v4 claim/attempt boundary and must never consume stale v2 delivery.
The exact vendor mt5api.dll is unsigned and no licence or notice material grants commercial, local, cloud, or SaaS use. Written vendor rights evidence is required.

Reachable history retains Testing/Mq5.zip in three commits, the credential-bearing vendor Examples.cs in two commits, and one historical Telegram token redacted from current evidence. Affected credentials require revocation or rotation plus coordinated remote history, cache, and fork remediation; no secret values are reproduced.

artifacts/verification/toolchain/mt5-toolchain-isolation.v4.json verdict is isolated_runner_not_configured: IsolatedRunnerConfigured=False, SafeToCompileUntrustedMqlOnHost=False, SafeToExecuteSuppliedMqlOnHost=False. Per plan rule, MT5 compile/execution stays blocked.

0/166 MQL files are locally dispatch-ready: every target is gated on approved snapshot authority (approvalId/snapshotSha null); 108 are intrinsically unsupportedSemantics and 12 are intrinsic candidates for a later isolated type-check.

Grammar, type-check, restricted-IR lowering, semantic conversion, MetaEditor compilation, reference-parity, and runtime proof counts are all zero; no strategy may be represented as converted or runnable until the complete evidence chain exists.

The plaintext demo credential file remains host-local, untracked, and ignored. It was not read by this audit; rotation or removal is not evidenced, and the production secret provider remains unwired even though local DPAPI import evidence exists.

Canonical Simple_Classic_Trailing.mq5 bytes are all-NUL while a quarantined source-like candidate exists. Restoring different bytes requires an owner provenance decision followed by a complete inventory, dependency, plan, and persistence re-run.

verdict: The documented fail-closed foundation and deterministic scaffolding are evidenced, but goal closure remains open. Repository implementation blockers (authenticated requested-v4 transport/consumer/provider/restart wiring, trusted risk authority, and authenticated broker reconciliation proof) remain alongside external provenance, isolation, credential-remediation, compiler, and platform-snapshot actions.
